$comment: Offline advisory catalogue. Entries are intentionally small and reviewable; replace or extend it from OSV/GHSA exports. 'below' is the first fixed version. Rule ids CG-VULN-* map to control CG-CI-009.

advisories.title: Proxy-Authorization header leak on redirect
advisories.summary: requests forwards Proxy-Authorization to a redirected destination over HTTPS.

advisories.title: Request body not stripped on cross-origin redirect
advisories.summary: urllib3 can forward a request body to a redirected host when a 303 response is returned.

advisories.title: Arbitrary code execution through full_load
advisories.summary: PyYAML's full_load resolves arbitrary Python objects from untrusted documents.
advisories.remediation: Upgrade PyYAML to 5.4 or later and parse untrusted input with safe_load.

advisories.title: Command injection in template
advisories.summary: lodash template allows code injection through crafted template options.

advisories.title: Prototype pollution
advisories.summary: minimist is vulnerable to prototype pollution through crafted arguments.
